notes.subject: strongpela i stap oltaim
notes.rationale: אֵיתָן i min 'i stap oltaim/strongpela' — JPS i ritim 'Though firm be' olsem tok bilong tambu

notes.subject: ples bilong stap bilong yu i strongpela
notes.rationale: Sapos KJV/ASV: stori i tok 'strong em i ples bilong yu', o JPS: 'sapos em i strong olsem'

notes.subject: קיני/קנך
notes.rationale: Nem bilong lain Keni (קֵינִי) na tok 'nes' (קֵן) i wankain raun — Balam i yusim piksa bilong nes long lain Keni

translation: Na i lukim ⟨את⟩ ol Keni, na i singautim tok bilong em, na i tok: Ples bilong stap bilong yu i strongpela, na yu putim nes bilong yu long ston.

tokens.gloss: na i singautim tok bilong em
